name: Messenger M0 — manual test plan + defect log for a real-case walkthrough
description:
Objective: produce a repeatable, 30-minute MANUAL test script for the Messenger plus a defect-log template, so the team can run real-case tests on desktop and mobile today and report defects in a fixed format.

Why this profile: `analyst` writes unambiguous, executable test cases with expected results (its job is well-defined requirements/examples); `biblio` owns writing and organizing the document file in the repo.

Context (verified in the code):
- Messenger UI: `client/src/views/MessengerView.vue` renders channels from the `channels` getter (`client/src/store/chats.js`), which returns chats with `mode === 'channel'`.
- Channel list: `client/src/components/messenger/MessengerChannelList.vue` shows `chat.unread_count` in its badges — no code path ever sets that field, so badges are expected to stay empty.
- `MessengerGroupInfo.vue` is imported by the view but never rendered in the template.
- Unread rule today lives in `client/src/utils/chatUnread.js` and ONLY counts messages with `role === 'assistant'`.
- Each channel is opened in `ChatView.vue` (composer, mentions, threads via `parent_id`/`message_id`).

Steps:
1. Write `docs/messenger/test-plan.md` (create the folder) with 12–18 numbered cases covering: create channel; open channel on desktop; open channel on mobile (drawer + bottom nav); send message; receive message from a second session; unread badge expectation; channel members panel (expected: currently unreachable); @mention of an AI profile; create a thread from a message; refresh/reload persistence; channel with 2+ channels and search; light/dark theme.
2. Every case in a table: ID · precondition · steps · expected result · pass/fail · evidence (screenshot/log) · severity if fail.
3. Add a "Known-expected failures" section listing the three gaps above so a tester knows what is a known defect, not a new one.
4. Add a short "how to report" section: defect = ID + steps + expected vs actual + severity (blocker/major/minor).

Acceptance: `docs/messenger/test-plan.md` exists, is executable by a non-developer, and every case has an explicit expected result. No application code is changed by this task.

Target: D+2.
